info.title: Diafit API
info.description:
All endpoints require `Authorization: Bearer <token>` and only see the caller's own data.

- Collections: `GET /<resource>` (paginated: `limit`, `offset`; returns `{items, count}`), `POST /<resource>`, `POST /<resource>/bulk` (idempotent), `GET|PATCH|DELETE /<resource>/{id}`.
- Time filters are half-open (`start <= t < end`) and need a UTC offset.
- Errors are `{"detail": ...}`; validation errors are 422.

SleepStageType.description:
Sleep stage types from Google Health Connect.

Maps to Health Connect constants:
- STAGE_TYPE_UNKNOWN = 0
- STAGE_TYPE_AWAKE = 1
- STAGE_TYPE_SLEEPING = 2
- STAGE_TYPE_OUT_OF_BED = 3
- STAGE_TYPE_LIGHT = 4
- STAGE_TYPE_DEEP = 5
- STAGE_TYPE_REM = 6
- STAGE_TYPE_AWAKE_IN_BED = 7
SleepStageType.title: SleepStageType

SleepSessionIn.description:
Durations are derived from `stages` when given; the per-stage minutes are
only used for sources that report totals without individual stages.
